title: Hokkaido Voted Most Attractive Prefecture for 18th Time
paragraphs: Which part of Japan do Japanese people like the most? For the 18th year in a row, the answer is Hokkaido.

Every year, a company called the Brand Research Institute does a big survey about the 47 prefectures and 1,000 cities and towns in Japan. The company has done the survey since 2006, and it started including prefectures in 2009. In 2026, it got 31,666 answers from people in Japan. People were asked many questions, for example, how attractive each place is, if they want to visit it and if they know its local products.

Hokkaido was the most attractive prefecture again. It has been in first place every year since 2009. Hokkaido is Japan's northernmost main island, and it is very big. Visitors can enjoy many different things there, such as snowy cities, seafood markets, lavender fields, hot springs, ski resorts and wild nature.
According to a news report, Kyoto was second and Okinawa was third. Saga Prefecture, on the island of Kyushu, was in last place.

Cities in Hokkaido also did very well in the survey. Sapporo was the most attractive city in Japan. It was the 10th time that Sapporo was first. Hakodate was second, and Otaru was third. Furano, which is famous for its flower fields, was seventh.
In addition, the town of Yubari was first for food. Many people know it for its expensive melons.
It is important to know that the people who answered the survey were Japanese. Tourists from other countries may like different places.
